Building, merging and validating [Portable Microhaplotype Object (PMO)](https://plasmogenepi.github.io/PMO_Docs/) files.

Generated from the `--help` output of SeekDeep 3.0.2-dev. Run `SeekDeep <command> --help` to see the same for your installed version. Commands and flags are not case sensitive, and every command also takes `--help`/`-h` and `--getFlags`.

## addSpecimenMetaToPmo {#addSpecimenMetaToPmo}

Add the columns of a table as specimen fields in a PMO, columns that aren't in the PMO schema are added as custom fields

```bash
SeekDeep addSpecimenMetaToPmo --help
```

**Required Options**

*Miscellaneous*

| Flag | Description | Default | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--meta` | A tab delimited table with a header **(required)** |  | boost::filesystem::path |
| `--pmo` | The PMO file **(required)** |  | boost::filesystem::path |

**Optional Options**

*Writing Output*

| Flag | Description | Default | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--appendFile` | Append to file | `false` | bool |
| `--out` | Out Filename |  | boost::filesystem::path |
| `--overWrite` | Over Write Existing Files | `false` | bool |

*Miscellaneous*

| Flag | Description | Default | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--sampleCol` | The column with the library sample or specimen name | `sample` | std::string |

## addTargetGenomeInfoToPmo {#addTargetGenomeInfoToPmo}

Add each target's genome, insert and primer locations, and the genes its insert overlaps (gene_name as GENE_ID:GENE_NAME) to a PMO, from where SeekDeep genTargetInfoFromGenomes found the targets, targets can be in different genomes

```bash
SeekDeep addTargetGenomeInfoToPmo --help
```

**Required Options**

*Miscellaneous*

| Flag | Description | Default | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--locations` | The locationsByGenome directory of SeekDeep genTargetInfoFromGenomes **(required)** |  | boost::filesystem::path |
| `--pmo` | The PMO file **(required)** |  | boost::filesystem::path |

**Optional Options**

*Writing Output*

| Flag | Description | Default | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--appendFile` | Append to file | `false` | bool |
| `--out` | Out Filename |  | boost::filesystem::path |
| `--overWrite` | Over Write Existing Files | `false` | bool |

*Miscellaneous*

| Flag | Description | Default | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--genomeDir` | Directory with \<genome\>.2bit files for the reference sequence of each target |  | boost::filesystem::path |
| `--gffDir` | Directory with \<genome\>.gff files for the genes the targets overlap |  | boost::filesystem::path |
| `--preferredGenomes` | Genomes to use first, in order, for targets found in several genomes | `None` | std::vector\<std::string\> |

## mergeMinimumPmos {#mergeMinimumPmos}

Merge minimum PMOs, for example PMOs per target over the same samples, into one PMO, genomes and haplotype variants are carried over, PMOs with project, sequencing, bioinformatics or read count sections are refused

```bash
SeekDeep mergeMinimumPmos --help
```

**Required Options**

*Miscellaneous*

| Flag | Description | Default | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--contains` | Merge the PMO files in --directory with this in their name **(required)** |  | std::string |

**Optional Options**

*Writing Output*

| Flag | Description | Default | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--appendFile` | Append to file | `false` | bool |
| `--out` | Out Filename |  | boost::filesystem::path |
| `--overWrite` | Over Write Existing Files | `false` | bool |

*Miscellaneous*

| Flag | Description | Default | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--directory` | Directory to search for PMO files | `./` | boost::filesystem::path |
| `--pmos` | A list of PMO files to merge | `None` | std::vector\<std::string\> |
| `--programVersion` | Version of this program to record in the merged PMO | `3.0.2-dev` | std::string |
| `--recursive` | Search --directory recursively | `false` | bool |
